[[Major/Legends|Major]] '''Tilos Pak''' was a [[Selkath/Legends|Selkath]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who lived during the [[Third Galactic War]].<ref name="Supply-Side Justice" /> By [[3625 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Pak was a [[Quartermaster/Legends|quartermaster]] for the [[Selkath Isolationists]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]]. He was killed during the [[Invasion of Manaan]] by the [[Alliance Commander]].<ref name="Supply-Side Justice" />
